تستلهمين (form X)
# تَسْتَلْهِمِينَ (tastalhimīna) /tas.tal.hi.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# تُسْتَلْهَمِينَ (tustalhamīna) /tus.tal.ha.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
